data.title: Speed challenge: mask emails in the log
story: The login log still records full email addresses. That is personal data that must not appear in full.
Write mask_email(email): keep the first letter, replace the rest before @ with ***, and keep the domain. Example: budi@contoh.test becomes b***@contoh.test.

explanation: split("@") separates the name from the domain, and only the first letter of the name is kept. Personal data such as full email addresses must not be stored whole in logs.
hints: Try print("budi@contoh.test".split("@")). The result is a list of two parts.
The first part is the name: take its first letter with [0].
Join them: first letter + "***@" + the second part.
